2608.24582.title: $\texttt{findr}$: Transparent and Fair Credit Risk Decisions through Semi-Structured Regressions
2608.24582.paper_summary: Credit risk models increasingly need to combine predictive accuracy with transparent explanations and auditable fairness constraints. Logistic regression remains attractive because its coefficients are easy to interpret, but it can miss nonlinear structure. Flexible models can improve prediction, but their explanations are often post-hoc and may not describe the decision rule itself. We introduce $\texttt{findr}$, short for flexible, interpretable deep regression, a semi-structured framework for binary credit risk modelling that decomposes the logit into an interpretable structured component and an orthogonal neural residual. The orthogonalisation separates coefficient-based effects from residual nonlinear variation, while an in-processing Wasserstein penalty mitigates group disparities by comparing score distributions during training. The framework also includes diagnostics that measure the structured component's contribution to logit variation, decision agreement, and local directional consistency. We evaluate $\texttt{findr}$ in a simulation study and on eight public credit datasets using score-level accuracy-fairness frontiers. The results show that $\texttt{findr}$ behaves close to logistic regression when the signal is approximately linear, while recovering much of the predictive gain of neural models when nonlinear structure is relevant. The diagnostics identify when coefficient-based explanations remain close to the full fitted model and when residual variation must also be examined. These findings support semi-structured modelling as a practical way to make performance, fairness, and interpretability trade-offs explicit in credit risk decisions.
2608.24582.paper_summary_zh: 信用風險模型越來越需要將預測準確性與透明解釋及可審計的公平性約束相結合。邏輯回歸仍然具有吸引力，因為其係數易於解釋，但它可能會忽略非線性結構。靈活的模型可以改善預測，但它們的解釋往往是事後的，可能無法描述決策規則本身。我們介紹了 $\texttt{findr}$，即靈活、可解釋的深度回歸的縮寫，這是一個用於二元信用風險建模的半結構化框架，將邏輯回歸分解為可解釋的結構組件和正交神經殘差。正交化將基於係數的效應與殘差的非線性變化分開，而過程中的 Wasserstein 處罰通過在訓練期間比較得分分佈來減輕群體差異。該框架還包括診斷工具，用於測量結構組件對邏輯變化的貢獻、決策一致性和局部方向一致性。我們在模擬研究和八個公共信用數據集上使用得分級別的準確性-公平性邊界評估 $\texttt{findr}$。結果顯示，當信號大致線性時，$\texttt{findr}$ 的行為接近邏輯回歸，而在非線性結構相關時，則恢復了神經模型的大部分預測增益。診斷工具識別出何時基於係數的解釋仍然接近完全擬合模型，以及何時必須檢查殘差變化。這些發現支持半結構化建模作為在信用風險決策中明確表達性能、公平性和可解釋性權衡的實用方法。
